title: Gelfand character-space representation: actual spectrum, isometry, and surjective star-algebra construction

difficulty_reason: Primary is the full maximal-ideal-to-character and Gelfand representation construction, with the local Gelfand-formula/nonempty-spectrum analytic chain retained as part of the proof obligation. Resolvent analyticity and power-series radius exchange establish the spectral-radius bound; maximal Banach-algebra quotients give characters, the C-star power identity identifies norms, and a closed star-subalgebra range plus point separation proves surjectivity. The naturality rfl endpoints and final StarAlgEquiv.ofBijective wrapper are H1 in isolation and are not the selected primary.
